task.title: View roles and permissions
task.shortdesc: View details about the roles and permissions for User Access in the Red Hat Hybrid Cloud ConsoleRed Hat Hybrid Cloud Console from the Roles page.

ul.li: You are logged in to the Red Hat Hybrid Cloud ConsoleRed Hat Hybrid Cloud Console as a user who has Organization Administrator permission. You cannot log in to the Hybrid Cloud Console with your email address unless your email address is the same as your Red Hat login. For more information, see .
If you are not an Organization Administrator, you must be a member of a group that has the User Access administrator role assigned to it.

prereq.p: For a list of predefined roles provided by Red Hat, see Predefined User Access roles.
prereq.note: You cannot modify a predefined role.

step.cmd: Navigate to the Red Hat Hybrid Cloud Console > Settings > Identity & Access Management > User Access > RolesRed Hat Hybrid Cloud Console > Settings > Identity & Access Management > User Access > Roles. User Access roles are displayed. You can scroll through the list of all roles.

In the table, click either the role Name or the role Permissions to see details about the permissions assigned to the role. For example, if you click on the Cost Price List viewer role, you see the following information: rbac cost viewer permissions detail

info.note: An asterisk * indicates a wildcard permission. A wildcard permission grants access to all resource types and allows all operations for the applications in a role.
